g.text: Latest additional: residual-target class-pair retention by original loss mode
C/V/T = raw positive-negative pairs within full case / same saved event / same event and <=20 ms.
Shares sum original 1/n_case squared masses before division. NA = no case opportunities; zero retention is 0%.
E = observed, P = noise + anchor. Empty modes and populations remain explicit. Retrospective availability, no new AUC or causal effect.
